The '''Mathematical Society of the Republic of Moldova''' is ({{langx|ro|Societatea Matematică din Republica Moldova}}) is a [[non-governmental organisation]] promoting interests of [[mathematicians]].<ref>[http://www.math.ntnu.no/ems/council10/sofiatabledpapers/MoldovaPresentation.pdf Mathematical Society of the Republic of Moldova. An overview over the state of the mathematical activities in the Republic of Moldova] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110727191134/http://www.math.ntnu.no/ems/council10/sofiatabledpapers/MoldovaPresentation.pdf |date=2011-07-27 }}</ref><ref>[http://rson.justice.md/organization/view/1228 Societatea Matematică din Republica Moldova]</ref>
